body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> Koncept has introduced its Z-Bar LED desk lamp at CES 2006. This model features 66 super-bright LEDs on a fully-adjustable arm with a 40" reach. It comes in 5 metallic colors: silver, blue, black, aqua, and red.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
